speaker: Mr Ong Hua Han
text: asked the Minister for Health in view of the Health Sciences Authority's assessment of risdiplam which cited data showing improvements in motor function following 12 months of risdiplam treatment as compared with placebo or historical data, whether the Rare Diseases Fund can include medications, such as risdiplam, to treat spinal muscular atrophy.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The RDFC oversees the RDF's fundraising efforts and donor engagement.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: This is based on the clinical effectiveness of these treatments and if the RDF is adequate to support all known patients requiring the same treatment.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We hope that donors will consider supporting the RDF so that more treatments and conditions can be listed, and more patients can be supported.

speaker: Mr Ong Hua Han (Nominated Member)
text: It is good to know that the RDF is continuously reviewed to improve access for rare disease patients and is also considering greater transparency of the fund.

speaker: Mr Ong Hua Han (Nominated Member)
text: While I understand that the RDF is ultimately limited by donor contributions, are there considerations to modify the medicine eligibility criteria of the RDF, such that all the medicines that clearly enhance quality of life can be included, even if extension of life span is not evidenced?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: The RDF is actually set up and gets advice from an expert panel of senior doctors with experience in rare disease management and decides on a list of medicines and conditions covered under the RDF.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: So, actually, there is expertise in that space and many of them would be able to guide as to what would then be included in that list.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: So, these are some of the limitations of the RDF.
